rule.description: RACFAccount entitlement: do not match existing accounts
rule.comment: When using the RACF Account entitlement with the Identity Manager user application or Role Based Entitlements, accounts are created and deleted/disabled by granting or revoking the entitlement. Default policy does not match an existing account in RACF if the user is not entitled to an account in RACF. Modify or remove this rule if you want entitlement policy to apply to matching accounts in RACF. Notice that this may result in the RACF account being deleted or disabled.
